text:
alex: Heads-up: Summit Credit POC kickoff. They need SSE streaming + function/tool calls that return strict JSON (schema enforced), plus an on-prem agent. Can we align before the call at 11am?

mira: 11am works. Main security asks: customer-managed KMS for private deploys, SOC2 evidence, and audit log export.

samir: We support ephemeral tokens (default TTL 5m) for SSE. Quick connect example: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEM" "https://private.redwood.local/streams?model=redwood-stream-1"` Add `X-Tenant` for routing.

jordan: SDK snippets ready — will recommend sdk-node v1.3+ and sdk-python v0.9+. Node stream example: `for await (const c of client.stream({model:'redwood-stream-1'})){handle(c)}`. I'll add a small repo with nginx TLS termination + mTLS to agent.

alex: Pricing Q: they expect ~150k tokens/day for 4 weeks with spikes. Is PAYG or short reserved commit better?

samir: For 4-week pilots PAYG with burst cap is usually cheaper; reserved needs monthly commit. I'll post a 4-week estimate table.

mira: For structured output they want `summit_txn_v1`: tx_id, amount_cents, merchant_id, decision, risk_score. We'll provide a JSON Schema and a system prompt: `System: output ONLY JSON matching summit_txn_v1`. Also include validation step in runbook.

alex: They asked about failover: prefer on-prem but fallback to hosted if capacity low. Can we document latency/data residency tradeoffs?

samir: Yessmart routing supports fallback chains. Need to call out that fallback may send data to hosted infra unless tenant-masking is enabled. I'll add that note.

jordan: I'll push the sample repo branch and paste link. Mira will assemble security artifacts.

alex: Action items: Samir -> cost estimate, ephemeral creds how-to, loadgen by EOD. Jordan -> SDK snippets, nginx example, schema validation example. Mira -> SOC2 redacted + KMS doc + questionnaire.

presales-bot: Created Jira POC-2987 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-2987 and added checklist items.

alex: Thanks team, see you on the call. :thumbsup:
